name: bitacora-reminder
description: Reminds you to log the AI session in docs/bitacora-prompts.md (cátedra requirement per CLAUDE.md) if the working tree changed but that file wasn't touched.
trigger: on agent session stop / end of turn
condition: git status --porcelain is non-empty AND docs/bitacora-prompts.md is not among the changed paths
action: non-blocking notice to the user; does not stop or fail the session
command: status=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$status" ]; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$status" | grep -q "docs/bitacora-prompts.md"; then exit 0; fi; echo "Recordá actualizar docs/bitacora-prompts.md con esta sesión (requisito de la cátedra, ver CLAUDE.md)."
_note: This is a portable description of the hook logic. Claude Code's actual wiring for this hook lives in .claude/settings.json under hooks.Stop (Claude Code hooks are engine-specific and can't be symlinked from a single JSON key). Other tools with an equivalent lifecycle hook can reuse the `command` above verbatim.
